text: Decision: keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY as an environment override; store the optional local credential in a CLI-owned file with restrictive permissions.
Implemented source-qualified inspect routing. The CLI now accepts codex:42 and git:42 without treating their numeric IDs as interchangeable.
The ask command returned a 401. The environment key was stale; after removing that override, the stored credential worked in a fresh run.
A sample search for 'disk cleanup' returned eight events, including a commit and a related terminal session. No changes were made.
We discussed whether to persist retrieval scores. The trade-off was noted, but no approach was selected.
The old migration script is no longer used. We should probably delete its documentation after checking whether anyone still needs it.
Done: changed the default model to the pinned release after the latency review. The review's measurements are recorded elsewhere.
The timeout is 30 seconds now. I cannot tell from this note whether it was changed today or merely observed.
Could the result ordering explain the missing citation? We tried sorting by score, but the next run still omitted it; investigation continues.
Approved the smaller patch: keep the current retrieval path and change only the prompt wording. The patch itself has not been applied.
Decision: cap each ask response at eight evidence records because larger sets buried the relevant commit in review. This limit applies to future queries.
Implemented the eight-record evidence cap in the retrieval selector. A test with nine candidates now returns exactly eight.
Proposal: raise the evidence cap to twelve next month if users request more context. Nobody approved it and no code changed.
Citation IDs still disappear on the second query. We are testing cache invalidation as a possible cause; the cause and fix remain unknown.
Fixed a 401 by removing an obsolete key loader from shell startup. A fresh login now authenticates through the CLI credential store.
Until June 5, search grouped Git events by author timestamp rather than commit timestamp. Reports generated before that date may have incorrect day boundaries.
At 14:03, cargo fmt finished without changing any files.
Terminal output: /home/demo/projects/notes
CI job 418 is waiting for an available runner; no test result exists yet.
Reversed the earlier decision to retain complete prompt text. After a privacy review, the new decision is to store only source IDs in the audit record.
Experiment: boosting terminal events above commits hid seven relevant commits in twenty labeled queries. The boost was reverted; these failure measurements were kept.
At lunch we wondered whether the CLI should have a mascot. Nobody chose one or opened a task.
The patch landed. It fixes the issue from yesterday.
A local search for 'disk-agent' returned three Git hits and two session hits. No action followed.
2026-09-24T12:00:00Z DEBUG HTTP 200 17ms GET /health
The build is green right now, but deployment has not started.
Changed the search CLI message from 'No events' to 'No matching events'; the documentation and test were updated in the same commit.
We should change the search CLI message from 'No events' to 'No matching events' after copy review. No patch exists yet.
After the index migration, six Git events were missing. Rebuilding the index restored all six, and the regression test now passes.
The README lists Rust 1.98 as the minimum, but CI still uses 1.97. Compatibility has not been checked.
